backup.prepare.script_missing_msg: setup-workspace.sh is missing from the package. Please reinstall the app.

backup.task.board_hint: Auto-discovered from host tree *.conf files (configure the path above first)
backup.task.board_required_msg: Please select a board, or click “Refresh Boards”.

backup.run.restore_done: Restore finished. Power-cycle the device to verify boot.
